name: omnilab/col
description: Omnilab Catalogue of Life: a taxon or synonym of the Catalogue of Life by its COL id, by the GBIF key that names it (GBIF's taxonomy is the COL eXtended Release) or by its name - authority, rank, status, classification, vernacular names, distribution, scrutinizer, source record; its GBIF key and the iNaturalist, WoRMS or ITIS records COL names as cross-references; parent, accepted name and synonyms related - and a search of names, through ChecklistBank's API, no key needed.
